items.title: Poll shows broad broker support for independent MGA performance assessments
items.summary: Nearly four in five UK and Irish brokers want independent performance assessments to become a standard requirement for managing general agents, according to a Corin Underwriting poll.

items.title: Edinburgh Worldwide and Impax Environmental Markets set December votes for Saba merger
items.summary: Edinburgh Worldwide and Impax Environmental Markets have scheduled general meetings for 21 December to vote on a merger proposed by Saba.

items.title: Marsh, Markel, AXA XL and Orvia make senior appointments across specialty lines
items.summary: Four London market firms have announced leadership and underwriting appointments spanning digital infrastructure, political risk, equine underwriting and MGA operations.

items.title: Torbjörn Magnusson confirmed as Aberdeen chair following regulatory approval
items.summary: Torbjörn Magnusson is set to take over as Aberdeen Group chair starting 1 December after securing regulatory clearance.

items.title: Europcar questions whether GTA rate groups can keep pace with electric vehicles
items.summary: Europcar Mobility Group UK has urged motor insurers to review replacement vehicle supply chains as the growth of EVs and new brands challenges existing General Terms of Agreement rate groupings.

items.title: Pension payments unaffected by DWP cyber incident
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions has taken services offline as a precaution following a cyber incident, but confirmed pension and regular benefit payments remain unaffected.
